userStories.title: Add max3(a, b, c) to the math library with M3-prefixed tests
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add a named export `max3(a: number, b: number, c: number): number` to `src/math.ts` that returns the largest of the three numbers, and cover it with a new `describe('max3', ...)` block in `test/math.test.ts`.

**Motivation** — Callers of the math library currently have to nest comparisons (or chain `Math.max`) themselves to find the largest of three numbers; `max3` gives them that result in one call, matching the existing `add` / `negate` / `min2` surface.

**Approach** — The implementation strategy is left to the implementer: plain comparisons or `Math.max` are both acceptable. No new dependencies. Append the function to the existing module; do not restructure the file. Follow the established shape of the neighbouring exports in `src/math.ts` (named export, explicit `: number` return type, no default export). In `test/math.test.ts`, import `max3` alongside the existing named imports from '../src/math' and add a new `describe('max3', ...)` block after the existing blocks, using `test`/`expect` from 'bun:test'. Every new test name must carry the prefix `M3-AC<n>:`, matching the existing per-feature prefix style (`AC<n>:` used for `negate`, `N-AC<n>:` used for `min2`). Leave `add`, `negate` and `min2` and their existing tests untouched.

**Scope** — In: the new `max3` export in the existing `src/math.ts`, and a new `describe('max3', ...)` block with `M3-AC<n>:`-prefixed tests in the existing `test/math.test.ts`. Out: any change to `add`, `negate`, `min2` or their existing tests; any new file; any new dependency; any barrel/index re-export; pinning of NaN or signed-zero behaviour for `max3` (explicitly deferred by the feature).

**Interface**
```typescript
export function max3(a: number, b: number, c: number): number
```
acceptanceCriteria: max3(2, 9, 5) returns 9 — largest in the middle.

routing.reasoning: Single exported pure function appended to one existing file, plus one new describe block in the existing test file. Purely additive, no new dependencies, no new abstractions, standard repo patterns already demonstrated by min2. No security-sensitive surface, so the default tdd-simple strategy applies.

suggestedCriteria: max3 is callable as a named function typed (a: number, b: number, c: number) => number, so assigning it to that function type and calling max3(2, 1, 3) returns 3.
max3(4, 9, 9) returns 9 when the two largest operands are equal.
add(2, 3) still returns 5, negate(5) still returns -5 and min2(3, 7) still returns 3 after max3 is added.
negate(0) still returns canonical positive zero (Object.is(negate(0), 0) is true) after max3 is added.
outOfScope: NaN and signed-zero semantics for max3 (not pinned by this feature).
Changes to existing exports (add, negate, min2) or new files outside `src/` and `test/`.

analysis: Greenfield-scale, single-module change. Repository layout: `src/math.ts` (12 lines) exports three named functions with explicit return types and no default export — `add(a, b)` at src/math.ts:1, `negate(n)` at src/math.ts:5 (guards `n === 0` to return canonical `+0`), and `min2(a, b)` at src/math.ts:9 (thin wrapper over `Math.min`). `test/math.test.ts` (60 lines) is the only test file and mirrors the source one-module-per-file: `describe('add')` at test/math.test.ts:4, `describe('negate')` at test/math.test.ts:10 (test names prefixed `AC<n>:`), and `describe('min2')` at test/math.test.ts:26 (test names prefixed `N-AC<n>:`). The per-feature test-name prefix convention is therefore well established and this feature must follow it with `M3-AC<n>:`. Import style in the test file is `import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'` plus a relative named import from '../src/math' (no extension) — the new test block must reuse both. Tooling: `bun test` and `tsc --noEmit` (package.json:6-7), TypeScript strict with `include: ["src", "test"]` (tsconfig.json:10), moduleResolution `bundler`, no runtime dependencies. Risks: (1) regression risk to existing exports is low but non-zero because the same file is edited — `add`, `negate`, `min2` must remain byte-for-byte semantically identical, and `negate`'s `+0` canonicalization must not be touched; (2) every new public symbol must satisfy the strict-mode explicit-return-type requirement, which the existing functions all do; (3) test-name prefix drift — a plain `max3(...) returns ...` name would break the feature-traceability convention the repo relies on; (4) the spec explicitly leaves NaN/signed-zero semantics unpinned for `max3`, so a `Math.max`-based implementation and a plain-comparison implementation are both acceptable and tests must not assert either behavior. Migration path: purely additive — append one exported function to `src/math.ts` and one `describe('max3', ...)` block to `test/math.test.ts`; there are no consumers to update, no barrel/index file to amend, and no new files required. Dependency order: implementation and tests are trivially co-located in one story, so a single `tdd-simple` story covers the whole feature.
outOfScope: NaN and signed-zero semantics (not pinned by this feature).
Changes to existing exports or new files outside `src/` and `test/`.
